predicates.title: Credential checks
predicates.lead: The checks anyone may run on a courier's credential. A verifier learns only whether the courier meets one; approving a check is what lets them ask it.
predicates.list.title: Live checks
predicates.list.empty: No check is approved yet. Approve the first one.
predicates.registry.none: No registry is active right now: new checks wait for one.
predicates.idle.title: Nothing chosen
predicates.idle.body: Choose a check to see its registry rows or withdraw it, or approve a new one.
predicates.rows.title: Registry rows
predicates.rows.lead: Seal keeps one row per week: this week's and last week's. A row asks for a credential issued on or after its date.
predicates.create.title: New check
predicates.create.lead: Seal writes it to the registry within about ten minutes; until then verifiers cannot ask it.
predicates.field.label: Name
predicates.field.labelHint: What couriers and verifiers read, for example “Experienced courier”.
predicates.field.ratingHint: From 0 to 5, two decimals at most.
predicates.field.freshnessHint: From 1 to 365. A credential carries the numbers of the day it was issued.
predicates.rule.labelUnprintable: The name cannot hold line breaks or invisible characters.
predicates.rule.deliveries: Use a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.
predicates.rule.rating: Use a rating from 0 to 5, such as 4.5.
predicates.rule.daysActive: Use a whole number of days from 0 to 36,525.
predicates.rule.freshness: Use a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
predicates.withdraw.body: Verifiers stop being able to ask it once seal takes its rows out of the registry. What was proven under it stays readable.
predicates.withdraw.title: Withdraw “{label}”?
predicates.withdraw.confirmBody: Couriers will no longer be asked this check. Approving the same minimums later brings it back.
predicates.report.approved: Approved “{label}”. Seal is writing it to the registry.
predicates.failure.exists: A live check already asks for exactly these minimums.
predicates.failure.full: A class holds at most eight live checks. Withdraw one first.
predicates.failure.admin: Only an admin may approve or withdraw checks.
predicates.failure.gone: This check no longer exists. The list was read again.
predicates.failure.invalid: Seal did not accept these values.
predicates.keys.label: Keys
